assertion_analysis.failure_condition: No product condition: directory / fixed filename constructs the asserted prefix; redundant fixture assertion recorded as non-blocking and excluded from coverage.
Fails if run directory is lexically under the repository; fixture isolation only.
Fails if fixture creates repository dirt, independently measured by git status.
Fails if actual promotion or persisted ledger records any commit; [] is an independent expected result.
Fails if review-self refuses or selects wrong route; original relative-path resolver refuses both delivered shapes.
Fails if successful promotion leaves a live pointer, read independently after completion.
Singleton unpack fails if zero or multiple ledger rows exist; identity assertion fails if a different run was written.
Fails if repository seed.txt is accepted without a commit, refusal diagnostic changes, or refused operation deletes pointer or writes ledger.
Fails if repository collision, missing file or escaped symlink is accepted, or refusal mutates pointer or ledger; removing containment, is_file or collision checks admits corresponding invalid cases.
